name: Gymcatch
summary: Booking and customer management software for fitness studios, trainers and wellness businesses, with unlimited bookings and clients on one plan.
best_for: Personal trainers, fitness studios and wellness businesses that want simple class booking and client management at one flat monthly price
skip_if: you run a large multi-site chain, you need a US-based payment processor, you want a free plan, or you want a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: Card processing fees are charged on top of the subscription and we could not find the rates. There is no free plan or yearly price on the page. We found no dated changelog and have not used the product ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Gymcatch · From £10 +VAT per month with 1 month free, no card
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-16 on gymcatch.com/pricing, British pounds a month) Gymcatch is booking and customer management software for fitness and wellness businesses. It costs from £10 + VAT a month with the first month free and no credit card required. The plan has unlimited bookings, customers and team members. Bolt-ons cost £2 + VAT each a month and are included in the free month. Online payments run through GymcatchPay or Stripe, and processing fees are not included. The page says you can cancel at any time. We have not paid for a plan.
